items.title: The first direct Mac release
items.description: Download the signed, notarized Mac app, start a seven-day trial, or activate an existing license.

items.title: A Mac App Store edition
items.description: Trayage 1.0 is available on the Mac App Store, with Apple purchases and Restore Purchases.

items.title: Keep the review up to date
items.description: Choose how often Trayage checks the selected folder for changes, then refresh suggestions as downloads arrive.

items.title: Your definition of old or large
items.description: Set the age and file-size thresholds used to flag downloads for review.

items.title: Check what’s inside likely duplicates
items.description: Check candidate duplicates locally using file contents, beyond the initial filename and size suggestions.

items.title: Remember what you want to keep
items.description: Remember ignored files between reviews and restore them to the review when you need to.

items.title: A focused, local file review
items.description: Group disk images, likely duplicates, older or larger files, and recent downloads from one selected folder.

items.title: Cleanup that waits for your decision
items.description: Move selected, unchanged files to Trash after confirmation. Trayage does not empty the Trash.

items.title: At home in your menu bar
items.description: A menu-bar popover, a full review window, and a choice to show Trayage in the Dock too.

items.title: Light, dark, or your Mac’s appearance
items.description: Choose the look that suits your workspace, with the same review controls in each appearance.

items.title: Make the first review clear and safe
items.description: A redesigned overview, clearer file reasons, smart filters, sorting, and Glance or Quick review menu-bar views.

items.title: Check accessibility across the 1.1 workflows
items.description: Larger-text controls are available in direct 1.1. Full keyboard, VoiceOver, Voice Control, contrast, and other applicable accessibility checks still need validation before support claims are made.
